laws.rule: Moriah Harbour Cay National Park: fishing or taking, injuring or chasing organisms in no-fishing or sensitive zones needs authorisation. Even in areas zoned for fishing, the listed protected species may not be taken, including parrotfish, sharks and rays, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, octopus and seahorses. Spearfishing, nets and traps are barred in fishing-zoned areas of this park.

local-law.note: Only the named BNT park or trust properties checked, not district-wide conduct or coastal fishing outside park boundaries. The 2022 bylaws include park-specific fishing and hunting exceptions; no blanket no-fishing claim is made. Admission and permit fee amounts not checked in this record.
